system.description:
Advanced Move. When another PC comes to you for advice and you honestly tell them what you think is best, they gain Advantage Forward to do as you suggest.

When you give sound advice to a receptive NPC, roll+CHA.

success.label: Success!
success.value: They follow your advice as best they can and appreciate it enough to Favor you.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: They follow your advice as best they can.

failure.label: Miss...
failure.value: They either act against your advice or need your help; the GM will say which and how.
